últimos camaras.sql: SELECT dias_almac, mes_almac, canal, zona_cctv, nombre_camara FROM `cognitivedsai-herramientas.Seguridad_data.Camaras` ORDER BY dias_almac DESC LIMIT 50

camaras por canal.sql: SELECT canal, COUNT(*) as total FROM `cognitivedsai-herramientas.Seguridad_data.Camaras` GROUP BY canal ORDER BY total DESC

totales camaras.sql: SELECT canal, SUM(nvr_dvr) as total, COUNT(*) as cantidad FROM `cognitivedsai-herramientas.Seguridad_data.Camaras` GROUP BY canal ORDER BY total DESC

top camaras.sql: SELECT nombre_camara, canal, COUNT(*) as total FROM `cognitivedsai-herramientas.Seguridad_data.Camaras` GROUP BY nombre_camara, canal ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

resumen camaras.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_registros, COUNT(DISTINCT canal) as tipos_canal, COUNT(DISTINCT zona_cctv) as tipos_zona_cctv, SUM(nvr_dvr) as total_nvr_dvr, AVG(nvr_dvr) as promedio_nvr_dvr FROM `cognitivedsai-herramientas.Seguridad_data.Camaras`
